question: Select the most appropriate op on to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**operate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage suggests that sports and games are expected to function or perform at a high moral standard, making "operate" the most appropriate word to use.
 
• "Operate" conveys the idea of performing or functioning, which aligns with the overall tone of the passage regarding sports as a career that functions at a high moral level.
 
• Other options such as "dwell," "desynchronise," and "decide" do not fit the context as they do not suggest the idea of functioning or performing at a high moral level.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *In the contemporary times, sports and games are emerging as one of the brightest careers. It expects to operate__ at a very high moral plane. It demands honesty and transparency. Sports further demand continuous practice, hard work and ___2___ training. One must understand that sport not only has physical benefits but also ___3___ concentration and inner strength. Not only this, one who plays feels that ____4___ overall personality has undergone a change for better. Besides, social connectivity or networking, games develop ___5___ spirit in players.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dwell (विकसित होना): "Dwell" refers to living or staying in a place, which does not fit the context of sports operating at a high moral level.
 
• Desynchronise (विकृत करना): "Desynchronise" means to cause something to be out of sync, which does not match the intended meaning of performing at a high moral standard.
 
• Decide (निर्णय लेना): "Decide" refers to making a choice, which does not fit in the context of sports being expected to function at a high moral plane.
